beforeSubmitPrompt.prompt: Classify the request. These are always safe — do not block: PRD discovery, product thinking, raw founder insight, answer to an open question, informal product clarification, /prd discover, /prd note, /prd questions, /prd converge. /prd converge is a read-only synthesis mode that writes no files. Writes to docs/prd/notes/ and docs/prd/questions/ are capture artifacts — always allowed. Apply SISO only for: /prd update, mutations to PRD.md / state.md / history.md / archive/, implementation specs, tickets, architecture for execution, code edits, dependency changes, terminal commands. The hook must not run convergence or update logic itself.
